description: This file defines several data transfer object (DTO) classes for authentication-related requests and responses in a login management system, including registration, login, token refresh, token response, and logout requests.

classes.name: AuthDtos
classes.description: A container class for nested record classes representing various authentication data transfer objects.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: DTO for registration requests, capturing email, password, and display name with validation constraints.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for login requests, containing email and password with validation annotations.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: DTO representing the response containing access token, refresh token, and user roles.

classes.name: RefreshRequest
classes.description: DTO for token refresh requests, containing a refresh token.

classes.name: LogoutRequest
classes.description: DTO for logout requests, containing a refresh token.
